items.decisiveFact: The slot is held before authorization; decline or expiry must leave the slot available and produce no charge.
items.nearestAlternative: Confirming at hold time is attractive because capacity is secured, but it exposes a booking before authorization succeeds.
items.changedCondition: If the hold could not expire and authorization could not fail, there would be no failed-attempt compensation to coordinate.

items.learningObjective: Separate acceptance of a canonical metadata merge from the retryable search projection.
items.decisiveFact: The merge commits before indexing, remains accepted during an outage, and retries from its committed revision while preserving asset ID.
items.nearestAlternative: Waiting for search before committing looks safer, but directly contradicts the stated accepted-merge behavior during outages.
items.changedCondition: If the index were itself the canonical metadata owner, the authority boundary would differ; here it is explicitly a projection.
items.identityReason: The accepted primary decision remains coordinating the stated multi-step outcome across owners. This revision changes only the competing workflow representations and clarifies the case boundary; it does not retarget the orchestration objective.

items.changedCondition: If delivery were a private reversible staging step, it could precede final release; the prompt says it is externally actionable.
